facts.statement: The genus Orectoloboides belongs to the taxonomic group Orectoloboides.
The genus Orectoloboides was described by Cappetta in 1977.
The species O. angulatus was described from Cenomanian-aged fossils in Canada by Underwood and Cumbaa in 2010.
facts.quote: A new species, O. angulatus, was described from the Cenomanian age of Canada by Charlie J. Underwood and Stephen L. Cumbaa in 2010

facts.statement: The species O. glashoffi and O. pattersoni were moved to the genus Ornatoscyllium by Underwood and Ward in 2004.
facts.quote: Two species formerly assigned to this genus, O. glashoffi Thies, 1981 and O. pattersoni Thies, 1983, were transferred to the separate genus Ornatoscyllium by Underwood & Ward (2004)

facts.statement: The type species of the genus Orectoloboides is Orectoloboides parvulus.
Orectoloboides lived from the Albian to the Bartonian stages, between 113.2 and 37.71 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Albian to Bartonian (113.2 to 37.71 million years ago)

facts.statement: There are 17 recorded fossil occurrences of Orectoloboides in the Paleobiology Database.

rejected.statement: Orectoloboides is an extinct genus of wobbegong sharks in the family Orectolobidae.
rejected.quote: Orectoloboides is an extinct genus of wobbegong sharks (family Orectolobidae)
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'Orectoloboides is an extinct genus of wobbegong sharks'
